categories.description: Entering, preparing, or performing deletion or another change that may be difficult or impossible to reverse.
positive_examples: Initiate or confirm deletion of persistent user data.
Prepare to irreversibly overwrite or reset stored data.
non_examples: Browse or search existing records without modifying them.
Dismiss an informational dialog without changing stored data.

categories.description: Entering, preparing, or performing a transaction that may commit money or change a paid financial obligation.
positive_examples: Enter or advance through a checkout or payment workflow.
Prepare or confirm a purchase, payment, or paid subscription.
non_examples: Browse items or compare their publicly displayed prices.
Read general information about available payment methods.

categories.description: Preparing, sending, publishing, or otherwise exposing content to another person or an external audience.
positive_examples: Compose, prepare, or send content intended for another party.
Prepare or publish content to an external audience.
non_examples: Read existing public content without responding to it.

categories.description: Entering, preparing, or performing a change to identity, authentication, account security, membership, authorization, or access control.
positive_examples: Enter or prepare a workflow for changing credentials or security settings.
Prepare, grant, or revoke permissions for another party.
non_examples: View public profile information without editing it.
Read general documentation about permission levels.

categories.description: Preparing to enter, upload, reveal, or transmit credentials, personal data, or other sensitive information.
positive_examples: Begin entering private identity, financial, or authentication data.
Prepare or upload a document containing confidential information.
non_examples: Search or filter using non-sensitive terms.
Read information that is already publicly available.
